title: A Halász-type asymptotic formula for logarithmic means and its consequences
summary: We establish an asymptotic formula for the logarithmic mean value of a 1-bounded multiplicative function that is sharp in many cases of interest. We derive from it a variety of applications, making progress on several old problems. As a first application, we show that if $f$ is a completely multiplicative function taking values in $[-1,1]$ then there is a constant $c > 0$ such that for every $x \geq 3$, $$ L_f(x) := \sum_{n \leq x} \frac{f(n)}{n} > -\frac{c}{(\log x)^{1-2/π}}, $$ thus significantly improving on a 20-year-old result of Granville and Soundararajan.
